performance.verdict: CPL win is real but 7 leads in 28 days exposes thin volume, not efficiency.

findings.text: 28-day CPL is $249 on only 7 tracked leads; 3-day signal (Sep 8–10: 1 lead, $158 spend) confirms volume too thin to trust CPL trend.
Intake owner unconfirmed since Vivian left 7/7 — overdue 2026-08-31. Speed-to-lead automations may point at an empty GHL seat, blocking scale-up.
Booking bot battle-test (due 2026-07-31), Review Boost campaign, Financing page, Homer Glen branch, and LSA heating toggle (due 2026-09-01) — all overdue.
GBP actions dropped 73% week-over-week (133 total in 28d, 0 in last 4 days of series) and search clicks fell 81% — organic floor is eroding while paid is throttled.
GHL shows 520 opportunities created vs 39 won and 0 appointments in 28 days — 261 contacts with no booked appointments signals an intake or pipeline-stage leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner name, GHL login, and after-hours coverage — unblocks all budget scale decisions.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian left 7/7 and the intake seat is unconfirmed as of 2026-09-11. Contact Xavier or Nader to name the current owner, verify their GHL login is active, and confirm after-hours coverage is assigned. Success = a named person with confirmed GHL access by 2026-09-14. Until this is resolved the SOW scale-up gate cannot open and speed-to-lead automations remain at risk.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL pipeline: 520 opps, 0 appointments — identify which stage leads are stalling and whether automation handoff is firing.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 520 opportunities created and 39 won across 28 days, but 0 booked appointments — this is an intake or automation gap, not an ads delivery problem. Pull the pipeline stage breakdown in GHL to find where leads are stalling. Check whether the booking bot (overdue since 2026-07-31 per F3) is firing correctly. Success = a identified drop-off stage and a fix ticket raised by 2026-09-18.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL over next 7 days — 3-lead sample too small to confirm the 50% CPL drop; re-check 2026-09-18.
suggestions.monday_update: The 7d CPL delta shows a 50% improvement to ~$125, but the underlying 28-day window produced only 7 total leads and the 3-day signal (Sep 8–10) shows just 1 lead on $158 spend. No budget move is defensible on this sample size. Re-check on 2026-09-18: if Meta leads reach 5+ in the next 7 days with CPL holding below $175, a modest scale (+15% daily budget) becomes actionable.
